title: Misc. bug: Memory not released after `llama_model_free` if no prompt was run (Metal)
metal: fix memory leak if model is freed without any GPU operations
body:
## Overview

<!-- Describe what this PR does and why. Be concise but complete -->

Fixes https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/25937.

This PR works around a Metal bug where residency set memory is not released if the app never performs any GPU operations. This can happen if a user loads and then unloads a model but never sends any prompts.

We can work around the issue by scheduling a tiny bit of GPU work. (The performance cost of that is negligible.)

## Additional information

Full details: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/25937#issuecomment-5071196759

I have reported the Metal bug to Apple as [FB23959296](https://feedbackassistant.apple.com/feedback/23959296) (not public) and in their [developer forum](https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/839089) (public).
